method: Static review of pinned committed source; no inference run.

modules.title: Beltloader brake checks
modules.inputs: GM aircraft/doors/BL/obstacles; BL tracks with optical-flow points, movement state and identity; view configuration.
modules.outputs: One Pass/Fail/Not observed result plus report/timeline; any failed eligible loader causes failure.
modules.attention: Do not replace its recomputed status with generic tracker status without replay comparison; seconds vary with configured FPS.

modules.title: Aircraft wheel chocks
modules.inputs: Pixels; GM chocks, wheels, nose/aircraft, pushback/towbar, cones and transport; worker/GSE/BL/aircraft tracks.
modules.outputs: THREE policy results in order: front_placed, main gear, front_removed, with parallel reports/timelines.
modules.attention: Front-removed success includes sustained chock presence after attachment; this is ordering evidence, not an explicit removal-edge detector. Preserve multiple task IDs instead of flattening the repository to one result.

modules.title: Cargo-door opening evidence
modules.inputs: GM front/back door, main aircraft and transport/obstacles; aircraft motion state and camera view.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Does not verify a BL target-door relationship or independently distinguish mechanical open/closed state beyond detector-label semantics.

modules.title: Beltloader chocks
modules.inputs: GM chocks/aircraft parts; BL tracks, front/back role and camera/aircraft layout.
modules.outputs: One result; all confirmed eligible visits must latch chocked; no visits is Not observed.
modules.attention: A one-time chock latch does not prove continuous chocking throughout the entire parked interval.

modules.title: Cone behind beltloader
modules.inputs: GM cones/doors/aircraft parts; BL tracks and role/view context.
modules.outputs: One result; all confirmed eligible BL visits must be coned.
modules.attention: Checklist and code thresholds differ; preserve code behavior as the migration baseline, then approve requirement changes separately.

modules.title: Staged cones and chocks
modules.inputs: GM cones/chocks and transport/obstacles; aircraft tracks/motion; metadata sufficient for central counting logic.
modules.outputs: Staged-equipment compliance result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: YAML 6/4 counts are not the active main-code 7/6 counts. Do not assume every configuration value controls behavior.

modules.title: Conditioned-air removal and stowage
modules.inputs: Pixels; GM nose/pushback and aircraft motion; full hose history and departure time.
modules.outputs: Combined decision with separate removal/stowage evidence in the internal decision routine and report.
modules.attention: Held boxes are counted repeatedly in current history. Evidence is a visual area/position proxy, not an observed disconnected coupling.

modules.title: Cone removal ordering
modules.inputs: GM wing/engine/tail cones, wheels/aircraft parts and obstacles; BL/aircraft tracks.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Despite its name it does NOT test whether GSE is chocked, and its equipment coverage is narrower than all GSE. A chocked prerequisite is new functional work.

modules.title: Aircraft cone placement
modules.inputs: GM typed wing/engine/tail cones, aircraft and transport obstacles; camera/aircraft type.
modules.outputs: One policy; normal return also contains counters/stage data (five values versus three on early paths).
modules.attention: Obstacle report text says 40% while code tests 65%; inconsistent return arity requires an explicit legacy adapter.

modules.title: Pre-arrival crew presence
modules.inputs: GM person counts and transport obstacles; aircraft arrival/motion; clip start time.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline based on crew exposure in the eligible window.
modules.attention: This measures counts over a window, not continuous presence of the same three named workers for ten minutes.

modules.title: Pre-arrival FOD walk
modules.inputs: Pixels; worker tracks, GM aircraft/front wheel/parts and vehicle detections; approach trajectory.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Not the simple horizontal-crossing rule in the basic description; bbox-derived scale is not calibrated physical distance.

modules.title: GSE chocks
modules.inputs: Pixels; GSE tracks/motion, GM chocks, persons, BL and occluding transport/objects.
modules.outputs: Per-GSE stop evidence aggregated to module result; failed eligible cases cause failure.
modules.attention: Different chock evidence channels have different semantics; current truthy fusion must be made explicit before sharing.

modules.title: Beltloader hand signals
modules.inputs: Pixels; workers/BL/aircraft tracks, doors and obstacle detections; stop episodes and view/layout.
modules.outputs: One result over observable eligible BL visits; unobservable visits can be omitted when others qualify.
modules.attention: Raised wrists are a coarse gesture proxy, not an approved signal vocabulary. Same HRNet checkpoint as steering does not imply same crop preprocessing.

modules.title: Beltloader handrail use
modules.inputs: Pixels; workers and BL tracks, aircraft/door/engine/wheel context, transport/person occluders.
modules.outputs: Pass when all evaluated climbers have contact plus positive coverage; Fail for a sufficiently covered non-contact case; none evaluated is Not observed.
modules.attention: Whole-body hands are required; do not substitute body-only pose. Unknown climbers are excluded rather than forcing global unknown in current aggregation.

modules.title: Arrival marshaller and wing walkers
modules.inputs: GM aircraft parts/people/obstacles and aircraft/worker tracks; arrival motion.
modules.outputs: One role-position result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: No separate pose/wand model or lead-marshaller signal proof on the active path.

modules.title: Steering-pin verification action
modules.inputs: Pixels; worker/aircraft tracks, nose wheel/pushback/aircraft and obstacles; departure and attachment evidence.
modules.outputs: One verification result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Measures a verification-like worker action, not direct pin visibility. Current 1.5/2.5-second criteria differ from the supplied description.

modules.title: Post-arrival walk-around
modules.inputs: Pixels, workers/BL/aircraft tracks and aircraft-part detections; camera/layout and arrival/loading gates.
modules.outputs: Result, report/timeline and technical evidence (canvases/CSV/JSON).
modules.attention: Post-arrival rescue/outlier options are disabled by default. Score-derived confidence is not demonstrated calibrated probability; required cached geometry must exist.

modules.title: Pre-arrival safety huddle
modules.inputs: Pixels; GM cones and big vehicles, worker/aircraft tracks, cone-relative perspective ROI and arrival observation.
modules.outputs: One huddle result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Pinned cv_common ac5098d lacks imported PlaneArrivalDetector. A candidate implementation exists at cv_common 2759daf, not at the reviewed pin.

modules.title: Pre-departure walk-around
modules.inputs: Pixels; aircraft parts, worker/BL/aircraft tracks; latest loading end, departure evidence and pushback obstruction.
modules.outputs: Result/report/timeline plus technical trajectory/geometry/classifier evidence.
modules.attention: Pinned cv_common e4c5e36 lacks imported departure/presence helpers. The reported five-minute wording does not match the 480-second code window. Torch and Keras paths must remain separate profiles.

modules.title: Wing walkers at pushback start
modules.inputs: Worker/aircraft tracks, aircraft parts and person/pushback/obstacle detections.
modules.outputs: One readiness result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Current evidence is post-start co-motion, not a direct proof that everyone was ready before start. Global role flags require per-turn state isolation.

modules.title: Pushback pathway clearance
modules.inputs: GM aircraft nose/tail, BL/GSE/fuel truck/trailer/cone/chock/ladder and pushback; aircraft motion.
modules.outputs: One pathway result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Current hazard class list does not include people. Variable pushback_moving uses aircraft state, not an independent pushback motion state.

modules.title: Beltloader rail extension
modules.inputs: Pixels; BL/aircraft tracks, front/back role, camera context and stopped-state evidence.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline; no qualified loader is Not observed.
modules.attention: 480 frames is about 60 seconds at 8 FPS, not eight minutes. Shared classifier reuse needs artifact/preprocessing identity.

modules.title: Vest fastening
modules.inputs: Pixels; GM vest/person boxes and worker tracks; no turnaround stage required by the core rule.
modules.outputs: One result; person dictionary nonempty without final unzipped states returns Pass; no associated workers returns Not observed.
modules.attention: No keypoint pose despite the model name. Current unknown/undefined workers can coexist with Pass; do not silently strengthen semantics during extraction.

modules.title: Pre-arrival safety-zone clearance
modules.inputs: Pixels; aircraft/front-wheel/cone detections and approach tracks; transport/person detections and motion masks.
modules.outputs: One result; unknown if uncertain exposure exceeds passing exposure, otherwise Pass absent enough violations.
modules.attention: Upstream tracker does not cover every transport class currently tracked here. FOD and safety-zone ROIs are related but not identical.

modules.title: GSE seat-belt use
modules.inputs: Pixels; GSE movement state, GM people/vehicles/obstacles and aircraft stage; local Norfair worker tracking.
modules.outputs: One result/report/timeline plus CSV debug output.
modules.attention: No authoritative equipment-is-seatbelt-equipped source is present. Visual heuristics do not prove hardware availability; sample videos are absent from videos_by_module.

modules.title: Steering bypass installation
modules.inputs: Pixels; workers, aircraft/front wheel, obstacles and arrival state; camera-specific wheel ROI.
modules.outputs: One installation result/report/timeline.
modules.attention: Distinct learned installation task from heuristic pin verification. Chock detections are collected but do not establish chocking prerequisite.

modules.title: Wing positions and approved wands
modules.inputs: Worker/aircraft tracks, GM aircraft parts/pushback/persons/obstacles and movement history.
modules.outputs: Position result plus wand sub-result and associated report/timeline structures.
modules.attention: CRITICAL semantic gap: approved-wand Pass is hard-coded on the active path. Old wand-count code is not called; merely extracting it would not preserve active behavior or establish correctness.

modules.title: Camera ingestion and full-turn assembly
modules.inputs: Camera chunk manifests/storage/DB, 60-second video chunks nominally 8 FPS, persisted camera/turn candidate state.
modules.outputs: Merged full-turn media plus DB/session metadata and processed-chunk state.
modules.attention: Its coarse capture boundary is not identical to downstream arrival/departure semantics. Keep clip and analytic-stage versions distinct.

modules.title: General-model pipeline
modules.inputs: Merged video/pixels, inference configuration/class mappings, model artifacts and worker metadata writer.
modules.outputs: general_model<video>.ndjson; camera/entity/aircraft type, stage/statistic dictionary, noise and broken-image information.
modules.attention: Airplane height replaces normal detection confidence in the output array. Do not treat every fifth numeric field as probability.

modules.title: Tracking and semantic vehicle state
modules.inputs: Video pixels, GM NDJSON, class mappings, DeepSORT/tracked-object configuration and utility pins.
modules.outputs: trackers<video>.ndjson: Track serialization, vehicle private state_dict, and BL role data.
modules.attention: Only GSE/BL get general vehicle tracking here; downstream safety-zone still tracks other transport. Serialized private fields tightly couple consumers to implementation versions.

modules.title: Shared CV library
modules.inputs: Model/runtime configs, pixels/detections, track state and geometric inputs supplied by callers.
modules.outputs: Python APIs/classes rather than one pipeline stream.
modules.attention: Standalone master is not every module dependency. Missing helper imports at selected pins must be resolved deliberately, not via blanket submodule update.

modules.title: Media, artifact, worker and reporting infrastructure
modules.inputs: Media/storage/DB/Kafka configuration, model and task IDs, weights/inference artifacts and module return values.
modules.outputs: NDJSON, task statuses/reports/timelines, technical artifacts and job execution status.
modules.attention: Replace positional row joins and private filename conventions with explicit identity. Legacy tuple/task-array adapters must preserve multiple results and optional extras.

components.title: Metadata and loader-state adapter
components.contract: GM boxes + serialized BL tracks -> local aircraft, obstacle and Loader state.

components.title: Door target and approach vector
components.contract: Aircraft door history + loader position -> target location and direction toward the aircraft.

components.title: Loader eligibility
components.contract: Box size, track history and target/ROI visibility -> whether this approach can be evaluated.

components.title: Local motion replay
components.contract: Stored optical-flow measurements -> locally recomputed moving/stopped status; does not simply accept upstream tracker status.

components.title: Orientation and reversing
components.contract: Loader motion + target vector + camera view -> approach/reverse evidence; sustained cone-view reverse motion resets progress.

components.title: Stop confirmation and counting
components.contract: Ordered motion history -> debounced stop count; 40-frame stop confirmation and preceding movement requirement.

components.title: Track replacement continuity
components.contract: Lost/new track state -> inherited approach history rather than a fresh visit.

components.title: Brake-check visit policy
components.contract: Eligible loader stop count -> visit result; more than three stops represents three checks plus final docking.

components.title: Multi-visit result and evidence
components.contract: Evaluated loader visits -> aggregate status, report and timeline; a failed eligible visit can fail the module.

components.title: Wheel detection cleanup
components.contract: GM wheel boxes -> deduplicated wheel observations.

components.title: Frame-sequence selection
components.contract: Buffered frame/time candidates -> observation sequences for wheel-region comparison.

components.title: Pushback reference prepass
components.contract: Late-turn pushback detections -> median reference box before departure; video is subsequently read again.

components.title: Pushback attachment proxy
components.contract: Pushback/aircraft proximity history -> attached flag after sustained overlap/proximity, not mechanical coupling detection.

components.title: Beltloader-clear evidence
components.contract: Door-associated loader and rear-wheel vehicle histories -> clear/not-clear debounce.

components.title: Rear-wheel assessment phase
components.contract: Attachment + loader-clear events -> analysis start; returning loader resets the phase.

components.title: Wheel localization and clipping
components.contract: Wheel-box history + image bounds -> stable wheel crop and crop-validity evidence.

components.title: Wheel-region obstruction
components.contract: Obstacles + wheel region over time -> blocked windows and comparison eligibility.

components.title: Rear chock assignment
components.contract: GM chock boxes + rear-wheel ROI -> direct chock-presence evidence.

components.title: Before/after frame buffers
components.contract: Wheel-region images + phase events -> retained baseline and later samples.

components.title: Initial wheel-image comparison
components.contract: Initial buffered wheel crops -> initial difference evidence.

components.title: Main wheel-image comparison
components.contract: Later wheel crops and reference samples -> main temporal difference evidence.

components.title: Supporting comparison channel
components.contract: Additional wheel observations -> support evidence when primary comparison is insufficient.

components.title: Difference classifier
components.contract: Paired/difference wheel imagery -> learned change classification using the aircraft-specific EfficientNet profile.

components.title: Rear-wheel evidence fusion
components.contract: Direct chocks + image-change channels -> rear-wheel chocking judgment.

components.title: Front chock presence and obstruction
components.contract: Nose-wheel region + chock/obstacle detections -> front presence and visibility histories.

components.title: Front placement policy
components.contract: Arrival time + front presence duration -> placement judgment within the arrival-relative window.

components.title: Front removal policy
components.contract: Pushback phase + front presence history -> removal-labeled result; current rule does not directly detect a removal edge.

components.title: Timeout and missing-evidence handling
components.contract: Incomplete wheel observations + elapsed time -> bounded assessment and unknown evidence.

components.title: Three-result output adapter
components.contract: Front placement, main-gear and front removal judgments -> ordered module results, reports and timelines.

components.title: Aircraft and door metadata adapter
components.contract: GM detections + aircraft tracking state + view -> aircraft, door and obstacle observations.

components.title: Arrival and pre-arrival evidence
components.contract: Aircraft motion/optical-flow history -> arrival proof and whether the approach was visible.

components.title: Scene blockage accumulation
components.contract: Obstacle area over time -> sustained blockage evidence with a clear-frame reset.

components.title: Camera-specific cargo-door selection
components.contract: Cone/wing camera profile + door detections -> relevant front/back door observations.

components.title: Door-presence accumulation
components.contract: Selected door detections -> cumulative visible-frame count; not independent verification of every cargo bin.

components.title: Observation completion window
components.contract: Door evidence and phase -> delayed end of collection after the qualifying period.

components.title: Door-opening result policy
components.contract: Door exposure + arrival/visibility evidence -> Pass, Fail or Not observed with Pass precedence.

components.title: Report and timeline adapter
components.contract: Final judgment + evidence interval -> existing module return format.

components.title: Detection and track adapter
components.contract: GM boxes + BL track payload + aircraft state -> typed local observations.

components.title: Active loader and door-role selection
components.contract: Loader/aircraft-part geometry -> front/back service-loader assignment with part-based fallback.

components.title: Loader track handover
components.contract: New track near a recent loader -> retained visit history within the configured frame gap.

components.title: Loader parking history
components.contract: Box overlap and movement history -> stabilized stopped loader and minimum-stay eligibility.

components.title: View-specific chock region
components.contract: Loader bounds + view + aircraft type -> expected chock ROI.

components.title: Chock presence accumulator
components.contract: Chocks intersecting the ROI -> decaying evidence counter and latched chocked state.

components.title: Scene layout sampling
components.contract: Aircraft/loader layout observations -> representative geometry used for chock assessment.

components.title: Lost-loader lifecycle
components.contract: Last-seen frame and track state -> stale loader finalization.

components.title: All-visit chocking result
components.contract: Eligible loader visits -> module report and timeline; each relevant visit contributes.

components.title: Detection and track adapter
components.contract: GM boxes + loader track state + aircraft state -> local cone, loader and layout observations.

components.title: Service-loader selection
components.contract: Door/aircraft geometry + tracked BLs -> relevant front/back loader.

components.title: Loader lifecycle and continuity
components.contract: Current and previous loader tracks -> persistent visit state and expired visits.

components.title: Parking and stay qualification
components.contract: Loader box/motion history -> stable parked visit after the minimum stay.

components.title: Loader viewing-direction classifier
components.contract: Loader/aircraft geometry -> side/enface profile used by the ROI calculation.

components.title: Rear safety-cone ROI
components.contract: Loader bounds and view profile -> expected region behind the loader.

components.title: Cone-footpoint persistence
components.contract: Cone bottom point in rear ROI -> consecutive-frame confirmation and latched cone-present state.

components.title: All-visit cone result
components.contract: Qualified loader visits and confirmed cones -> aggregate report and timeline.

components.title: Aircraft motion-state adapter
components.contract: Tracked aircraft state -> local motion/arrival context.

components.title: Relevant equipment observations
components.contract: GM cones, chocks and vehicles -> size-filtered staged-equipment candidates.

components.title: Arrival and approach visibility
components.contract: Aircraft history + optical flow -> arrival proof and pre-arrival collection eligibility.

components.title: Transport-carried chock exclusion
components.contract: Chock positions + vehicle boxes -> chocks considered on the ground rather than on transport.

components.title: Equipment-count exposure
components.contract: Ground chocks and cones per frame -> cumulative qualifying exposure; active code uses at least seven cones and six chocks.

components.title: Pre-arrival window closure
components.contract: First confirmed arrival -> stop collecting staging evidence.

components.title: Visibility and staging decision
components.contract: Count exposure + pre-arrival/blocked evidence -> staged-equipment result.

components.title: Evidence timeline
components.contract: Decision and selected frame bounds -> report interval in the downstream format.

components.title: Sparse hose object detection
components.contract: Video frames -> conditioned-air hose boxes from best28_full.onnx, sampled every 40 frames.

components.title: Held observations and history
components.contract: Last hose detection + nose/pushback boxes -> per-frame histories; held results are not independent model samples.

components.title: Coverage eligibility
components.contract: Hose and nose history lengths -> whether enough observations exist; threshold counts include held samples.

components.title: Departure-relative assessment window
components.contract: Aircraft stop/departure times -> full window ending ten minutes before departure or short-turn fallback.

components.title: Hose-use evidence
components.contract: Hose box areas in first/interior periods + nose relation -> apparent deployment/use of the hose.

components.title: Return-to-stowed appearance
components.contract: First-minute baseline and final-minute hose areas -> return within the configured 30 percent range.

components.title: Pushback occlusion exception
components.contract: Final hose location + nearest-time pushback box -> partial-overlap Not observed outcome.

components.title: Removal versus stow sub-decisions
components.contract: Deployment and final area change -> separate internal removal/stow judgments, including late-removal failure.

components.title: Short-turn policy
components.contract: Less than ten minutes of stopped time + hose/nose relation -> failure or unobserved fallback.

components.title: Combined result adapter
components.contract: Internal sub-decisions + departure availability -> combined returned judgment and timeline.

components.title: Aircraft layout history
components.contract: Door and aircraft-part detections -> layout used to associate cones and equipment.

components.title: Typed cone confirmation
components.contract: Cone type + consecutive detections -> confirmed cone and last-seen time.

components.title: Relevant equipment proximity
components.contract: Loader/equipment locations + aircraft layout -> nearby-equipment presence history; not a complete all-GSE inventory.

components.title: Cone occluder association
components.contract: Obstacle overlap + recent obstacle state -> retained obstruction evidence around a cone.

components.title: Last-seen event comparison
components.contract: Last relevant cone and transport observations -> whether cones persisted until equipment was clear.

components.title: Departure and observability gate
components.contract: Missing departure or obscured cone disappearance -> Not observed instead of an unsupported ordering judgment.

components.title: Removal-order output
components.contract: Ordering/visibility judgment -> report and timeline; GSE chocked state is not actually tested.

components.title: Cone-role requirement profile
components.contract: Camera view + aircraft type -> required engine/wing/tail cone roles and counts.

components.title: Scene and typed-cone observations
components.contract: GM cone labels + aircraft/obstacle metadata -> per-role observations; no extra cone model in the active decision path.

components.title: Role-presence exposure
components.contract: Per-role cone detections -> cumulative evidence exceeding the frame threshold.

components.title: Per-role placement result
components.contract: Required roles + accumulated cone evidence -> role-level placement assessment.

components.title: Arrival and scene visibility
components.contract: Arrival evidence, blocked fraction and off-frame tail -> whether missing cones can be judged.

components.title: Result and return-shape adapter
components.contract: Role judgments + observability -> report/timeline; normal and early-return shapes currently differ.

components.title: Crew-count observation
components.contract: GM person detections -> frame-level crew count; not proof of unique staff identities or roles.

components.title: Arrival and usable pre-arrival evidence
components.contract: Aircraft motion + obstacle history -> arrival reference and usable crew observations.

components.title: Arrival-relative crew window
components.contract: Arrival time and video coverage -> nominal minus-12 to minus-8 minute window, with a shorter-clip fallback.

components.title: Crew exposure accumulator
components.contract: Frames with at least three people -> accumulated qualifying duration in the selected window.

components.title: Short/blocked observation policy
components.contract: Insufficient pre-arrival footage or excessive obstruction -> Not observed.

components.title: Crew-presence result and timeline
components.contract: Qualifying exposure above ten seconds + visibility -> final crew result and evidence interval.

components.title: Worker and vehicle filtering
components.contract: Person tracks + vehicle boxes + phase -> pre-arrival workers excluding likely vehicle occupants.

components.title: Person pose estimation
components.contract: Worker image crops -> MoveNet Thunder body landmarks used by walking-direction analysis.

components.title: Camera-specific pseudo-depth
components.contract: Person box height and camera profile -> approximate relative depth, not calibrated metric depth.

components.title: Worker facing direction
components.contract: Pose landmarks and trajectory observations -> facing/orientation evidence for a candidate walk.

components.title: Aircraft approach corridor
components.contract: Aircraft/front-wheel history -> retrospective inspection corridor and approach reference direction.

components.title: Worker trajectory collection
components.contract: Pre-arrival worker identities and positions -> time-ordered candidate paths.

components.title: Corridor traversal test
components.contract: Worker path + corridor endpoints -> duration, endpoint-coverage and directional checks.

components.title: Arrival/visibility eligibility
components.contract: Arrival proof + blocked fraction -> whether a missing FOD walk is assessable.

components.title: FOD-walk result and evidence
components.contract: Accepted traversals + observation quality -> module decision and selected walk evidence.

components.title: Vehicle motion measurement
components.contract: Vehicle crops, feature points and frame history -> optical-flow motion measurements.

components.title: Orientation-window estimation
components.contract: Recent motion windows -> vehicle orientation used to choose wheel and action profiles.

components.title: Vehicle eligibility and clipping
components.contract: Vehicle box dimensions + image bounds -> usable vehicle ROI and minimum-size eligibility.

components.title: Parking episode confirmation
components.contract: Vehicle motion history -> parked state after the required stationary duration.

components.title: Rider/worker association
components.contract: Person positions + vehicle geometry -> occupants versus external workers.

components.title: Wheel-region construction
components.contract: Vehicle orientation and box -> expected chock/wheel analysis region.

components.title: Direct chock persistence
components.contract: Chocks in the wheel region -> consecutive confirmation of placed chocks.

components.title: Worker action ROI
components.contract: Vehicle geometry + worker trajectory -> eligible wheel-interaction observations.

components.title: Worker pose estimation
components.contract: Person crops -> RTMPose landmarks for bending/action evidence.

components.title: Bending/placement heuristic
components.contract: Worker height change, feet stability and pose confidence -> candidate chock-placement action.

components.title: Negative action and visibility evidence
components.contract: Observable worker activity without qualifying action -> negative/unknown action channel.

components.title: Obstruction history
components.contract: Wheel ROI + obstacles -> retained visibility and comparable obstacle states.

components.title: Reference-image buffering
components.contract: Vehicle stop/departure and wheel crops -> before/after sample buffers.

components.title: Learned wheel-change comparison
components.contract: Reference and later wheel imagery -> difference-classifier evidence using the GSE-specific model profile.

components.title: Assessment timeout
components.contract: Unfinished vehicle evidence + elapsed frames -> close the assessment window.

components.title: View-dependent evidence fusion
components.contract: Direct chocks, action and image-change channels + orientation -> vehicle chocking judgment.

components.title: Vehicle-result aggregation
components.contract: Eligible vehicle judgments -> report and timeline, preserving unobservable cases.

components.title: Pose-crop preprocessing
components.contract: Worker crop -> contrast-adjusted image using CLAHE.

components.title: Body pose estimation
components.contract: Prepared worker crops -> HRNet body landmarks and scores.

components.title: Aircraft door reference prepass
components.contract: Door detections over the video -> representative docking geometry before main processing.

components.title: Service-loader state and selection
components.contract: GM loader boxes + tracks + aircraft layout -> active approach/docking loader state.

components.title: Helper-person interaction region
components.contract: Loader geometry + worker boxes -> helper ROI and worker candidates.

components.title: Worker observation eligibility
components.contract: Person history and geometry -> eligible helper observations.

components.title: Pose/history buffering
components.contract: Eligible worker frames -> persisted landmarks and worker histories around a loader stop.

components.title: Helper selection and signal window
components.contract: Persistent nearby workers + loader stop time -> candidate helper and minus-30 to minus-5 second window.

components.title: Raised-arm signal heuristic
components.contract: Wrist/elbow landmarks over the window -> sustained raised-arm evidence; not classification of a signal vocabulary.

components.title: Loader identity handover and expiry
components.contract: Current/new/lost loader tracks -> continuous visit state and finalized visits.

components.title: Layout and ROI-coverage sampling
components.contract: Aircraft/loader geometry -> saved layout and ROI coverage; coverage argument does not itself gate the signal check.

components.title: Visit result aggregation
components.contract: Signal observations by loader visit -> report/timeline; unknown visits may be omitted when others are observable.

components.title: Loader view classification
components.contract: Loader and aircraft geometry -> viewing profile for rail-use analysis.

components.title: Rail-extension appearance classifier

components.title: Rail segmentation
components.contract: Loader imagery -> SegFormer rail mask.

components.title: Rail mask coordinate mapping
components.contract: Crop-local rail mask + loader bounds -> full-frame rail geometry.

components.title: Climber-to-loader association
components.contract: Worker boxes/feet + loader region -> people currently using this loader.

components.title: Whole-body/hand pose estimation
components.contract: Associated person crops -> DWPose landmarks, including hand keypoints.

components.title: Feet and hand visibility
components.contract: Pose scores + crop geometry -> usable feet and selected hands.

components.title: Geometric hand-to-rail contact
components.contract: Hand trajectory + rail mask/line geometry -> temporally confirmed proximity/contact evidence.

components.title: Climb observation coverage

components.title: Hand-contact appearance fallback
components.contract: Hand/rail patches -> contact classification when direct geometric evidence is insufficient.

components.title: Deferred contact assessment
components.contract: Previously unobservable climb samples + later evidence -> delayed contact assessment.

components.title: Active-loader phase gate
components.contract: Aircraft phase and loader tracks -> visits on which to run rail-use analysis.

components.title: Climber and visit aggregation
components.contract: Observable climber contact results -> module report; unobserved climbers are not equivalent to proved compliance.

components.title: Arrival-window observation collection
components.contract: GM persons/aircraft parts + tracked movement -> candidate arrival-period worker histories.

components.title: Worker movement representation
components.contract: Worker paths + camera-dependent geometry -> smoothed movement direction and relative travel estimates.

components.title: Wing-walker path qualification
components.contract: Worker movement vectors -> minimum-length and direction-compatible paths.

components.title: Opposite-side position test
components.contract: Qualified worker paths + aircraft reference geometry -> evidence of walkers on both sides.

components.title: Approach visibility and blockage
components.contract: Aircraft parts, arrival coverage and blocked fraction -> whether positions can be assessed.

components.title: Position result and evidence
components.contract: Qualified side coverage + observability -> result/report; no separate lead-marshaller gesture recognizer is implemented.

components.title: Aircraft-part history
components.contract: GM aircraft parts -> reference layout for nose-wheel and pushback regions.

components.title: Pushback and wheel interaction regions

components.contract: Per-model iterators -> one metadata dictionary by positional zip/first value, without an event-time join.

components.title: Metadata writer initialization
components.contract: Model/video identity and output mode -> NDJSON output handle.

components.title: Per-frame result publication
components.contract: Model payload + publication call -> serialized record or messaging payload; internal counter does not honor supplied frame_id.

components.title: Kafka topic setup
components.contract: Video/model topic identities -> producer/consumer topic configuration.

components.title: Kafka input collection
components.contract: Messages from upstream consumers -> combined metadata by arrival order, not keyed event-time alignment.

components.title: Kafka output delivery
components.contract: Serialized model payload -> producer send to the downstream topic.

components.title: Completion and archive lifecycle
components.contract: End marker and worker close -> topic/file archive and resource cleanup.

components.title: Inference artifact upload
components.contract: Completed local metadata files -> cloud inference artifacts.

components.title: Retry and cloud-transfer helpers
components.contract: Transfer operation and failure -> bounded retries for upload/download.

components.title: GM-derived configuration handoff
components.contract: GM camera type and stop frame -> report/config updates consumed by later stages.

components.title: Runtime configuration preparation
components.contract: Job/video settings -> production detector configuration mutations.

components.title: Model-weight provisioning
components.contract: Repository/DVC configuration -> downloaded weights before inference.

components.title: General-model job runner
components.contract: Job source/config -> invoked GM and upstream job outcome.

components.title: Tracker job runner
components.contract: GM metadata + source/config -> tracker execution and job outcome.

components.title: Downstream module invocation
components.contract: Task identifier, source and metadata -> dynamically imported detector call.

components.title: Multi-result/task output mapping
components.contract: Detector return arrays and task mapping -> individual compliance results, reports and timelines.

components.title: Technical failure reporting
components.contract: Runtime exceptions or failed processing -> error report distinct from a compliance Fail.

components.title: Report validation and delivery
components.contract: Module result fields and evidence -> validated report object and HTTP delivery.
